notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
description:
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Leafkin Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Leafkin Druid.
Repeat.
